strongest_angle: Address to the Nations reimagines history from Indigenous perspective, sparking nationwide debate and inspiring inclusive futures.

key_facts.fact: Address to the Nations, a televised project, presents three Indigenous narratives that rewrite key events in Australian history.
The project features David Pledger, Tony Briggs, and actor Sherry-Lee Watson as its creators.
The Address to the Nations project has sparked nationwide debate about Indigenous perspectives in Australian history.
Creative project reimagines history from First Nations perspective, highlighting Indigenous narratives in Australian history.
